areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: Not the program focus, but hospital capacity expansion with an acceptable objective and SMART indicator; resource share is low because funds are spread across areas.

areas.name: Early childhood and education
areas.reason: Daycare construction with objective and product, but indicator counts only places created (not SMART); resources dispersed and the increment over baseline marginal.

areas.name: Human rights
areas.reason: Single older-adult care center product with under 1% of resources; indicator lacks a baseline, so not SMART; impact minor.

areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Single women's care center product; indicator counts only service volumes, not results, and resources are dispersed; impact minor.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Integrated sanitation, drainage, mobility and urban requalification with significant component resources, but indicators not clear enough to be SMART, limiting impact assessment.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Stream and spring recovery plus waste planning, with some SMART indicators; dispersion of resources and localized recovery target limit impact.

areas.name: Family farming
areas.reason: Agro-processing unit relevant to the general objective, but indicators count raw output and trained farmers (not SMART), resources dispersed and impact on value added unclear; potential low.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Drainage objective and product exist, but indicators do not measure prevention, risk management or disaster response capacity, so impact cannot be gauged.

areas.name: Decarbonization
areas.reason: Program logic does not cover new-technology industrialization or decarbonization; no components or indicators clearly aligned.

not_accepted.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
not_accepted.reason: Drainage objective and product exist, but indicators do not measure prevention, risk management or disaster response capacity, so impact cannot be gauged.

not_accepted.name: Decarbonization
not_accepted.reason: Program logic does not cover new-technology industrialization or decarbonization; no components or indicators clearly aligned.

bonus.reason: Proponent did not state the program is exclusively aimed at federal PPA priorities.
Proponent did not state the program promotes regional integration.
